source_note: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变
english_source_note: Characteristic Polynomial Invariant Under Order Swap
callout_id: 矩阵交换次序特征多项式不变#6
statement_en: Let $A,B\in M_{n}(\mathbb{C})$. Then the minimal polynomials of $AB$ and $BA$ differ by at most a factor of $x$.
callout_body: $A,B\in M_{n}(\mathbb{C})$那么$AB,BA$二者的极小多项式至多相差一个因子$x$
